name: @zhenre/store
description: @zhenre store — global singletons via defineStore, component-scoped stores via useStore with automatic teardown on component unmount or list-row removal. Signal-based, zero dependencies.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --external:@zhenre/core --outfile=dist/store.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --external:@zhenre/core --minify --outfile=dist/store.min.js && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
